scope: Independent source bytes, native coordinates, labels and unchanged derived mesh transport; no anatomy or clinical approval

publisher.description: Probabilistic maps for 35 subcortical structures from the entire high-resolution sample of the AHEAD database (18 to 80 year old, 97 subjects). A parcellation as well as average and standard deviation maps for each individual structure are provided, all in MNI2009b space (note that the voxel data is stored in RPS, not RAS).

Group template of R1, R2*, QSM and derived myelin and iron maps for the AHEAD database, co-registered to MNI2009b space (note that the voxel data is stored in RPS, not RAS). Maps include the population median ('med') and inter-quartile range ('iqr').

arrays.source_bit_comparison_qualification: Decoded label bytes are uint8 IDs, not the original float32 storage. Every ID matches and uint8-to-float32 reconstructs every original crop bit.

geometry.method: Independent polygon-plane clipping: exact on-plane vertices and strict opposite-sign edge intersections via symmetric barycentric formula; retain boundaries of coplanar patches; direct orientation-invariant segment-vector distances and bijective nearest matching.
